text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“—Take my hand, Flash-senpai. It's an 
honor to walk beside you.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. ...However, before we head to 
the party venue, please allow me to say it 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Rose-san. May you—and the 
noble Rose clan—continue to bloom in full 
glory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I thank you from the bottom of my heart 
for your kind words. —Lady Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us make a promise. When the roses 
build their kingdom, I shall become a king 
worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Then I, too, shall run in a way worthy 
of that promise. For our pledged dream, 
and for my own honor.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Blessed is the one to whom your sword, so 
overflowing with grace and pride, is 
offered.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I, too, shall dedicate myself to daily 
self-improvement, so that I may become a 
lord worthy of the sword I am destined to 
meet one day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. In 5 minutes and 10 seconds, the 
birthday party will begin.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides the lavish dishes, there's also 
junk food at the venue. Just so everyone 
can relax and enjoy themselves.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Are there proper table manners when eating 
junk food? If you wouldn't mind, please 
instruct me.
